input.quote: 12.4 Customer shall not solicit, hire, or employ any Vendor employee during the term or for twenty-four months afterward, regardless of how the employee applies.
input.rationale: Section 12.4 is the only non-solicitation provision in the document, and it fails the fallback on every material term: it binds Customer only (not mutual), covers any Vendor employee rather than personnel directly involved in the Services, runs for the term plus twenty-four months rather than 12 months after involvement ends, contains an express no-hire ("hire, or employ"), and rules out both a general-advertising and an unsolicited-approach carve-out ("regardless of how the employee applies"). A no-hire covering all Vendor personnel is walk-away territory. It also contradicts Section 12.3, in which Vendor acknowledges Customer has made no no-hire commitment. We therefore target the preferred position and replace the restrictive words with confirmation that Customer takes no non-solicitation restriction, which also removes the internal conflict with 12.3. The separate Section 12.4 non-compete is a different commercial term and is not flagged here.

proposal.summary: Replace the one-sided 24-month no-hire/non-solicit in Section 12.4 with a confirmation that Customer takes no such restriction.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a one-sided bar on soliciting, hiring or employing any Vendor employee for the term plus 24 months, expressly including people who approach us unsolicited; we have replaced it with confirmation that Customer takes no non-solicitation restriction, consistent with Section 12.3. If Vendor needs protection we could consider a mutual non-solicit limited to personnel directly involved in the Services for 12 months after their involvement ends, with carve-outs for general advertisements and unsolicited approaches and no no-hire.

ops.oldText: Customer shall not solicit, hire, or employ any Vendor employee during the term or for twenty-four months afterward, regardless of how the employee applies.
ops.newText: Customer is subject to no restriction on soliciting, hiring, or employing any Vendor employee.
